description: Contextual exceptions for gigabuild-dev. Single-file static app — styles.css is both token definition AND primary stylesheet. No build step separates token definitions from component styles.

exceptions.reason: Standalone brand favicon SVG served as external image. Cannot reference CSS custom properties in an external SVG context. Brand colors (#050505 Black, #e8a020 Gold, #ffffff White) are technically required as literal hex in SVG attributes. DR-033 authority: standalone-SVG technically-necessary exception.

Static HTML files served directly without a build pipeline (index.html, privacy.html, delete-account.html). Theme-color meta and inline brand color attributes are technically required literal hex values. DR-033 authority: static-HTML PWA-meta and inline-attribute technically-necessary exception.
